craft_reasoning: Farafield owns no factory and names no factory or mill on any page I read. It states five making countries and says its factories are visited regularly, and it describes the Istanbul knitwear partner (since 1989, second generation, over ten years together), but without a name. That is a country stated with a described, unnamed partner, so a 2; a 3 would need a named workshop or mill. Sebastian rules.
owner_today: Far Afield Ltd, UK company 08090708, incorporated 31 May 2012 (third-party aggregator listing); persons with significant control listed: Mark Scholes and Thomas Anthony Wands. The brand calls itself independent and family-run.
